title: Rodent baiting and bait boxes
subtitle: Draft. Only what is already written down is here. Questions for Mitch are at the bottom.
source: LPC Tech Onboarding Pack (PPE, never list, what you can quote); jobbook-data/chemicals.json (Rodent Treatment and Rodent Boxes products); jobbook-data/services.json (past wordings); business-context notes (quarterly default, external boxes)

sections.heading: When this job comes up
body: Rodent baiting, bait station checks and bait box cleaning. Mitch's services are Rodent Treatment and Rodent Boxes (supply). Past invoices read: "Inspect, clean and refill rodent bait boxes", "Rodent Baiting", "Rodent Baiting to ceiling" and "Supply refillable tamperproof rodent bait boxes".
Rodent baiting usually comes back every quarter. That is Mitch's default, and he can change it for a client.

Internal rodent baiting goes with a pest visit. External baiting needs tamper-proof boxes, and existing boxes are re-used. This is decided on the day. [Mitch to confirm: should a tech decide that on site, or call you?]
Once you are experienced you can quote a bait box refill. Anything complex, and commercial jobs, go to Mitch.
The job process, the never list, PPE and the free service period are in the Every job guide. [Mitch to confirm: does the free service period apply to this job?]

sections.heading: PPE
sections.title: PPE on before you go in
sections.note: Never apply chemicals without PPE. If the SDS requires it, you wear it. No exceptions.
items: Gloves and closed shoes at minimum

items.text: Gloves at all times when handling traps or bait
items.detail: Wear them every time you touch a bait box or any bait.

items.text: Roof void entry: dust mask, gloves, torch, appropriate footwear
Subfloor entry: coveralls, gloves, dust mask, torch

sections.heading: Products Mitch uses
sections.title: All of these go in rodent bait stations. Names as in Mitch's product list. No rates here: follow the label. [Mitch to confirm: which bait for which situation, and which is your standard]
rows: Talon GT Pro Rodenticide Grain Block

Boxes can be supplied and installed outside.

sections.heading: Tell Mitch straight away if
sections.body: Call Mitch on 0432 181 689. After hours or urgent, call Mitch directly.

items.detail: Stop immediately. Do not continue. Call Mitch.
Follow the SDS procedure. Call Mitch immediately. Never leave a spill unattended.
Treat the injury first. Call Mitch. Write down what happened.

items.text: The customer complains or gets aggressive
items.detail: Stay calm and do not argue. For a complaint, tell them Mitch will call them today. If they are aggressive, remove yourself. Call Mitch either way.

items.text: The customer asks for a quote on anything complex, or you are not sure
items.detail: Say "I'll need to get Mitch to come and have a look and provide a quote for that."

items.text: You see signs of termites or other pests outside this job
items.detail: Photograph it and tell Mitch. Termite quotes always go to Mitch.

sections.heading: Mitch to fill in
sections.title: Answer each in one line and this guide is done
items: 1. How many bait boxes go on a standard house, and where do they go (along walls, corners, how far apart)?
2. Which bait goes where (Talon GT Pro, Talon XT Pro, Roban, Fastrac, Generation First Strike, Selontra), and which is your standard?
3. How much bait goes in a box on a refill, or do you top up to a mark?
4. What do you record for each box (bait taken: none, some, all)?
5. What do you do when a box is eaten right out, or when nothing has been touched?
6. Do you use traps as well as bait? (The onboarding pack says gloves when handling traps or bait.)
7. How do you bait a ceiling void or cavity, and where in the void?
8. What happens to old or mouldy bait you take out of a box, and how do you clean the box?
9. What do you do about dead rodents you find, and who removes them?
10. How do you keep pets, kids and other animals away from bait?
11. When does a box need replacing, and when do you suggest tamper-proof boxes or more boxes?
12. Do you look at how they are getting in, and do you tell the customer about food storage or sealing gaps?
13. Which rodent jobs are commercial and go to you?
14. What do customers ask most about baiting, and what do you tell them?
